dataset_provenance: SYNTHETIC — 12,000 simulated Indian AI/Data job postings (2024-2026). Not real labor-market data.

salary_model.evaluation_note: Metrics from held-out 20% test set. Model trained on SYNTHETIC salary data — output is a demonstration estimate.

known_limitations: Trained on synthetic data — not a real salary predictor.
Salary formula is deterministic with Gaussian noise — R² may be artificially high.
No cross-company or cross-location real benchmarks.
Model cannot be updated without retraining on new data.
